channel.title: Livable Telluride — Weekly Digest
channel.description: This week's upcoming Gov-Hub meetings and community events across the Telluride region (Town of Telluride, Mountain Village, San Miguel County, the Sheridan Opera House, The Alibi, Wilkinson Library, KOTO, telluride.com, and more).

item.title: 📅 The Week Ahead — Nov 21–27
item.description: It's a holiday week, so the government calendar is quiet — no agendas have been posted for any of the four scheduled meetings, meaning no public decisions to track right now. What the week does have is community: Alpine Chapel's free Friendsgiving on Sunday, the Turkey Trot on Thanksgiving morning, and a People's March on Saturday for anyone who wants to show up for something beyond the dinner table. Enjoy the valley and the people in it.

item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Program Room 10:00 AM – 11:00 AM · Move, breathe, and energize in this dynamic bilingual class, led by Lauren Norton, designed to uplift your body and mind! item.title: [Tue, Nov 24] Around The World: America’s Pumpkin Beer & Chocolate Pretzels
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Wine Mine, Telluride Owner and Brewmaster, TJ is taking us on a journey to early America to discover how a humble native gourd became our continent’s most iconic seasonal tradition. Long before pumpkin spice became a modern phenomenon, early American colonists relied on native pumpkins to survive winter and celebrate the harvest holidays. Join us for a curated tasting event exploring the rich history of American pumpkin brewing paired with traditional European-style chocolate pretzels. Grab your tasting passport, explore the global trade routes that brought us holiday spices, and toast to the historic flavors of the American harvest season! (Ages 21+ only).

Sign up at any time and get started weekly. Fridays — 11:15-11:40 am @ Lone Cone Library Norwood K to 3rd Grade week Session 8 Week Winter Session $150 for the 8 sessions. Thursdays – 430-530 pm @ Lone Cone Library Norwood For more information and to register: Contact Tia @ liv2danz247@gmail.com or find us on Facebook!
